earth_latest_high_prec.bpc.comment: earth_000101_270111_261015.bpc, created 2026-10-15 by NAIF WRTPEM 7.0.0 from JPL's EOP series (latest.long); ITRF93 from ecliptic J2000 by IAU 1976 precession, IAU 1980 nutation with nutation corrections, true sidereal time and polar motion; Chebyshev fits of degree 20 over at most a day; last datum 2026-10-15 UTC

eopVintageCheck.result: eop-2026-06 rows agree with the current file to 0.004 mas and 0.005 ms. eop-2026-08 rows were not yet final when the fixture was made: x pole up to 2.01 mas, y pole 0.50 mas and UT1-UTC 0.095 ms from the current values (MJD 61252-61256). Every tool in the cross-validation reads the same rows, so this cancels in each comparison.
